title: India regains top spot in ICC T20I rankings after series win
summary: The Indian cricket team regained the top spot in the ICC T20I rankings after a 4-0 series win against England. The team, led by Shreyas Iyer, had previously lost to England but bounced back to reclaim its position at the top. India's ranking was affected by the recent loss, and the team's performance in the series helped it regain the top spot. The ICC T20I rankings are updated regularly based on teams' performances in international matches.
summary_points: India regained the top spot in the ICC T20I rankings
The team won a 4-0 series against England
Shreyas Iyer led the Indian cricket team
The ranking was affected by the recent loss to England
